stories.title: BlackRock's proposed Bitcoin ETF would hold no Bitcoin
stories.summary: BlackRock has filed a new Bitcoin ETF proposal. The fund would not hold actual Bitcoin, and it would not hold shares of BlackRock's existing spot Bitcoin ETF either, per CryptoSlate. The report does not detail what the fund would hold instead.
stories.whyItMatters: Investors who buy a Bitcoin ETF expect exposure to Bitcoin's price; a structure that holds neither the asset nor a spot ETF raises questions about what they would actually own.
whatToWatch: Further detail on the fund's actual holdings or mechanism
questions: What does the fund hold if not Bitcoin or spot ETF shares?
How closely would it track Bitcoin's price?

sources.title: BlackRock’s proposed Bitcoin ETF would hold no Bitcoin or spot ETF shares

stories.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows pull $630 million ahead of Ethereum as BlackRock leads
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have seen renewed inflows that put them about $630 million ahead of Ethereum ETFs, per CryptoSlate. BlackRock's funds account for the bulk of the gap. The split points to investors favoring Bitcoin over Ethereum in ETF flows right now.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flow data is one of the clearest signals of institutional demand, and a widening gap shows where that demand is currently concentrated.
whatToWatch: Whether the Bitcoin-Ethereum ETF flow gap widens or narrows
Ethereum ETF flow figures in coming weeks
questions: What is driving the shift back toward Bitcoin over Ethereum?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETF comeback exposes a $630 million divide with Ethereum as BlackRock dominates

stories.title: JPMorgan launches JPM Coin on Ethereum, blocks retail access
stories.summary: JPMorgan has deployed its JPM Coin on the Ethereum network, per CryptoSlate. The coin is restricted to institutional use, with no access for retail users.
stories.whyItMatters: A major bank building settlement infrastructure on public blockchain rails, while keeping it walled off from retail, is a concrete marker of how banks are adopting crypto technology on their own terms.
whatToWatch: Whether JPMorgan later expands JPM Coin access or use cases
Other banks making similar moves onto public chains
questions: Why did JPMorgan choose Ethereum specifically?
Will retail access ever open up?

sources.title: JPMorgan drops JPM Coin on Ethereum with zero retail access

stories.title: French lawmakers back crypto tax that targets stablecoin swaps
stories.summary: Members of the French parliament have backed a proposed tax on crypto activity, per CryptoSlate. The measure specifically targets stablecoin swaps. The report does not give the tax rate or the bill's full scope.
stories.whyItMatters: A stablecoin-focused tax in a major EU economy could shape how other European states approach stablecoin regulation.
whatToWatch: A full parliamentary vote on the bill
Reaction from exchanges and stablecoin issuers operating in France
questions: What tax rate and scope does the bill set?
Would it apply only in France or influence EU-wide rules?

sources.title: French MPs back crypto tax, and stablecoin swaps take the hit

stories.title: BNB Chain splits asset control into four roles, but admins still hold the key
stories.summary: BNB Chain has restructured its asset control permissions into four separate roles, per CryptoSlate. Despite the split, administrators still retain ultimate control.
stories.whyItMatters: The change touches on how centralized control over a major chain's assets really is, a core question for anyone assessing custody and security risk.
whatToWatch: Any further steps to reduce admin control
Security community reaction to the new role structure
questions: What happens if the admin role is compromised?
Does this change reduce centralization or just formalize it?

sources.title: BNB Chain splits asset power across 4 roles while admins hold the key

stories.title: Hyperliquid whale loses $469,000, then opens $16 million ETH short
stories.summary: A trader on Hyperliquid lost $469,000 within hours, per CryptoSlate. The same trader then re-entered the market with a $16 million short position on Ethereum. This is a single trader's activity, not a broader market signal.
stories.whyItMatters: The swing shows the scale of leverage and volatility risk on derivatives platforms like Hyperliquid, worth tracking even though it says little about where ETH's price is headed.
whatToWatch: Whether the new short position closes in profit or loss
questions: Is this isolated whale behavior, or does it reflect wider ETH sentiment?

sources.title: Whale loses $469,000 in hours on Hyperliquid, yet re-enters with $16M ETH short bet

stories.title: Crypto hacks jumped 55% to $1.2 billion, though key theft fell 30%
stories.summary: Total losses from crypto hacks rose 55% to $1.2 billion over the measured period, per CryptoSlate. Within that total, losses from stolen private keys fell 30%, suggesting attackers are shifting toward other methods.
stories.whyItMatters: Security incidents hit user funds and platform trust directly, making this a core metric for tracking risk in the sector.
whatToWatch: Which attack vectors are growing as key theft declines
Responses from affected protocols and exchanges
questions: What period and methodology does this figure cover?
Which attack types are replacing key theft?

sources.title: Crypto hacks surge 55% to $1.2B, but key theft drops by 30%

stories.title: Hoskinson unveils new Cardano code, but $63 million TVL exposes a gap
stories.summary: Charles Hoskinson presented new code for Cardano, per CryptoSlate. Cardano's total value locked stands at about $63 million, a figure the report frames as exposing a gap.
stories.whyItMatters: Total value locked is a core gauge of real DeFi activity, so a low figure alongside new development raises questions about actual adoption.
whatToWatch: Whether TVL moves after the code is released
questions: What does the new code actually change?
A gap compared to what benchmark?

sources.title: Hoskinson reveals new code for Cardano, but $63M TVL exposes a gap

stories.title: Binance launches free AI trading tool, but users bear full liability
stories.summary: Binance has rolled out a free AI-powered trading feature, per CryptoSlate. Users remain fully liable for any losses that result from using it.
stories.whyItMatters: AI trading tools are spreading quickly across major exchanges, and the liability terms matter because users carry all the risk.
whatToWatch: User adoption and any reported losses
Whether other exchanges match these liability terms or offer more protection
questions: What exactly does the tool do, and what is its track record?

sources.title: Binance opens free AI trading, yet user liability remains 100%

stories.title: Kraken's opt-in European wallet can let futures losses hit spot holdings
stories.summary: Kraken has introduced an opt-in unified wallet for European users that links spot and futures balances, per CryptoSlate. Opting in can expose a user's spot holdings to losses from futures trading.
stories.whyItMatters: Cross-margining features boost capital efficiency but add risk that casual users may not fully understand before opting in.
whatToWatch: How clearly Kraken communicates the risk to users
questions: What safeguards limit accidental full exposure?

sources.title: Kraken’s opt-in European wallet can expose spot holdings to futures losses
